edits.new_string:
-- (round 2) default 46 (pixel rounding left some at 43 px); clampTo = a frame the area must not outgrow (a Settings row,
-- a Shop rail slot), so neighbouring buttons' areas never overlap
function BrickUI.tapArea(button, onActivate, minPx, clampTo)
	minPx = minPx or 46

edits.old_string: local fx, fy = math.max(1, minPx / a.X), math.max(1, minPx / a.Y)
edits.new_string:
local fx, fy = math.max(1, minPx / a.X), math.max(1, minPx / a.Y)
		if clampTo and clampTo.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 then
			fx = math.min(fx, math.max(1, clampTo.AbsoluteSize.X / a.X))
			fy = math.min(fy, math.max(1, clampTo.AbsoluteSize.Y / a.Y))
		end
